core_obligations: Part (1): for g : Y -> X, the restrictions (g^*F)|_{V_etale} = F|_{V_etale} and comparison maps agree by Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-comparison, so g^*F has the flat base change property (proof lines 867-878).

Part (2): weak Serre subcategory via Homology, Lemma homology-lemma-characterize-weak-serre-subcategory; kernels, cokernels and the five-lemma step use exactness of f_{small}^* for flat f and of the etale restriction functors (proof lines 880-894).

Part (3): smooth covering descent; by (1), the definition of an algebraic stack, and smooth composition (Morphisms of Stacks, Lemma stacks-morphisms-lemma-composition-smooth) reduce to each X_i representable by a scheme; for a morphism of X over a flat map of schemes a : U -> U', lift using Sheaves on Stacks, Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-surjective-flat-locally-finite-presentation and compare the c_varphi maps (proof lines 896-934).

Part (4): colimits; the etale restriction of the colimit is the colimit of restrictions, f_{small}^* is a left adjoint hence commutes with colimits, and the colimit of the c_varphi isomorphisms is an isomorphism (proof lines 936-963).

Part (5): tensor products commute with pullbacks, Modules on Sites, Lemma sites-modules-lemma-tensor-product-pullback; the author marks this routine verification 'details omitted' (proof lines 965-968).

Part (6): internal hom; restrict the SheafHom to U_etale and U'_etale (etale topology), use Modules on Sites, Lemma sites-modules-lemma-pullback-internal-hom which needs f flat so that f_{small} is a flat morphism of ringed sites, and conclude the c_varphi arrow is an isomorphism (proof lines 970-1004).
proof_roadmap: Pullback stability; weak Serre; smooth descent; colimits; tensor (omitted detail); internal hom with flatness pinpointed.
difficulty_reason: Six-part closure: pullback stability, weak Serre, smooth covering descent, colimits, tensor, internal hom; each part written out with etale-restriction bookkeeping. H3: long with an omitted routine tensor detail.
